facts.fact: Camilla Marshall 拿着报纸闯进图书馆找 Caroline，说自己担心死了；Fletcher 告诉她 Zane 把 Caroline 藏在这里，等风头过去
facts.anchor: I’ve been worried sick ever since I read this. Fletcher finally told me that Zane brought you here until all this dies down.

facts.fact: 报纸头条：结婚不到一年，MRS. O. GREY 拿到离婚判决
facts.anchor: MARRIED LESS THAN A YEAR, A DECREE OF DIVORCE FOR MRS. O. GREY.

facts.fact: 报道指她每月 lifestyle 花费超过 15000 美元，并传她不忠
facts.anchor: Mrs. Grey was spending more than $15,000 a month on her lifestyle. Rumors of her infidelity—

facts.fact: 离婚是 Zane 办成的：编造狩猎旅行支开 Orson，再跑到 Cheyenne 拿签字
facts.anchor: I drew in a deep breath and told Camilla the entire story, from Zane inventing the hunting trip to get rid of Orson, to traveling out to Cheyenne with divorce papers.

facts.fact: Camilla 断言 Zane 爱 Caroline，理由是事故后几乎没出门，却远赴西部拿离婚签字
facts.anchor: And he went all the way out West to get Orson’s signature on your divorce papers? Trust me, he is in love with you.

facts.fact: Camilla 承认当年逼她整理 Zane 的藏书是为了让她离开 Orson，并要她今晚引诱 Zane，条件是别伤哥哥的心
facts.anchor: All I ask is that you do not break my brother’s heart.

facts.fact: Zane 段：Branson 按 Caroline 的吩咐在他办公室摆好晚餐，她穿着翠绿丝袍出现
facts.anchor: Heels clacked on marble, silk rustling, and then Caroline appeared, draped in a gown I hadn’t seen before.

facts.fact: 结尾 Zane 把她抱回自己房间，Branson 完全知情还要备餐
facts.anchor: I’ll have cook prepare a tray and will leave it outside your door. For when you both recover.
